what: a surface loft between a vertical line on XZ (bow) and a slanted line in the plane x = 100 (stern), stern to bow, guided by a keel rail lying in the bow sketch plane and a sheer rail at z = 20 (refused: "a guide rail crosses section 2's plane")
method: with straight sections and straight rails the surface is the bilinear patch S(t,s) = (100 t, 40 t s, 20 s), which contains both rails (s = 0: keel, s = 1: sheer) and both sections (t = 0, 1); S_t = (100, 40 s, 0), S_s = (0, 40 t, 20), cross = (800 s, -2000, 4000 t); A = double integral of its length = 2995.833 (Gauss-Legendre). One face, open (valid false); bbox 0..100, 0..40, 0..20. The loft is independent of the order of the sections.
